units.source_text: 当天夜里，信子对丈夫说起妹妹照子的婚事，

en.t: That night, Nobuko told her husband about her younger sister Teruko's marriage plans,

units.source_text: 丈夫像以往一样微笑，颇有兴致的听她模仿照子讲话的语调。

en.t: and her husband smiled as he always did, listening with considerable interest as she imitated the way Teruko spoke.

units.source_text: 但是，信子却觉得她是在对自己讲述照子结婚的事情。

en.t: But Nobuko felt as though she were telling herself about Teruko's marriage.
"All right, let's go to bed early."

units.source_text: ——两三个小时候之后，丈夫一边摸着胡子一边起身离开火盆。

en.t: Two or three hours later, her husband rose from beside the brazier, stroking his beard as he went.

units.source_text: 信子不知道送什么贺礼给照子好，

en.t: Nobuko did not know what wedding gift she ought to give Teruko,

units.source_text: 她无聊的用火筷子在炭灰上写字，

en.t: and, out of boredom, she wrote in the charcoal ash with the fire tongs,

units.source_text: 她抬头突然对丈夫说：“想到我也有妹夫了，总有些奇怪。”

en.t: then suddenly looked up and said to her husband, "It feels a little strange to think that I will have a brother-in-law too."

units.source_text: “这有什么奇怪的，你有妹妹啊。”

en.t: "What is strange about that? You have a younger sister, after all."

units.source_text: 虽然丈夫如是说，但信子还是若有所思般沉默。

en.t: Although her husband said this, Nobuko still fell silent, as if lost in thought.
